name: johnvc Google Flights API
description: Google Flights search for one-way, round-trip and multi-city itineraries, with filters for price, stops, airlines and passengers: prices, airlines, stops, layovers, durations, price insights and optional booking options. Hosted on Apify's MCP server; the tool is the pay-per-event Apify Actor johnvc/Google-Flights-Data-Scraper-Flight-and-Price-Search. Sign in with an Apify account (OAuth) or an Apify API token.
author: johnvc
